signature.name: VTask.pOrder
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {M : Type u_2} -> [Monoid R] -> [AddCommMonoid M] -> [DistribMulAction R M] -> {p : R} -> (hM : Module.IsTorsion' M ↥(Submonoid.powers p)) -> (x : M) -> [(n : ℕ) → Decidable (p ^ n • x = 0)] -> ℕ

conventions.statement: VTask.pOrder hM 0 = 0, since p^0 • 0 = 0 holds immediately.
conventions.note: The zero element has p-order 0 because the zeroth power already annihilates it.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [Monoid R] [AddCommMonoid M] [DistribMulAction R M] {p : R} (hM : Module.IsTorsion' M ↥(Submonoid.powers p)) (x : M) [∀ n : ℕ, Decidable (p ^ n • x = 0)], p ^ VTask.pOrder hM x • x = 0

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [Monoid R] [AddCommMonoid M] [DistribMulAction R M] {p : R} (hM : Module.IsTorsion' M ↥(Submonoid.powers p)) [∀ n : ℕ, Decidable (p ^ n • (0 : M) = 0)], VTask.pOrder hM (0 : M) = 0
